units.source_text: 于是，美概括了各部分的争执、矛盾和一切不协调，并且君临其上！

en.t: Thus beauty gathered up the conflicts, contradictions, and every disharmony among the parts, and reigned over them all!

units.source_text: 它如同用泥金一字一字准确地抄录在深藏青色册页上的纳经①一样，是一幢在无明的长夜里用泥金修建的建筑物。

en.t: Like a sutra offering copied accurately character by character in gold paint onto deep indigo pages, it was a building constructed in gold paint in the long night of ignorance.

units.source_text: 然而，我不知道美究竟是金阁本身还是与笼罩着金阁的座正之夜同一性质的东西！

en.t: Yet I did not know whether beauty was the Golden Pavilion itself, or something of the same nature as the solemn night that enveloped it.
Or perhaps both of them were beauty.

units.source_text: 美既是细部，也是整体；既是金阁，也是笼罩金阁之夜。

en.t: Beauty was both the details and the whole; it was both the Golden Pavilion and the night that covered it.

units.source_text: 这么一想，过去曾令我苦恼的金阔之美的币可解，仿佛有一半已经解开了。

en.t: Thinking this way, it seemed that the incomprehensibility of the Golden Pavilion's beauty, which had once tormented me, was already half resolved.

units.source_text: 因为倘使审视其细部前美，诸如其柱子、栏杆、板窗、板门。

en.t: Because if one examined the beauty of its details, such as its pillars, railings, plank windows, and plank doors,

units.source_text: 花格子窗、宝形造型的屋顶……其法水院、潮音洞、究竟顶、漱清亭……地面的投影、池心的小岛群。

en.t: its lattice windows, its pyramidal roof, its Hosui-in, Choon-do, Kukyo-cho, and Sosei-tei, the shadows on the ground, and the clusters of small islands in the pond,

units.source_text: 松村乃至油开石等等细部的美，就知道美决不是以其细部告终，以其局部完结的，而是任何一部分的美都包含着另一种美的预兆。

en.t: and even the beauty of such details as the pine grove and the stones, one would understand that beauty never ends with its details or concludes in its parts, but that the beauty of any one part contains the omen of another beauty.

units.source_text: 细部的美，其本身就充满着不安。

en.t: The beauty of the details was itself filled with unease.

units.source_text: 它尽管梦想着完整，却不知道完结，波唆使去追寻另一种美、未知的美。

en.t: Though it dreamed of wholeness, it knew no completion, and was urged on to pursue another beauty, an unknown beauty.

units.source_text: 于是，预兆联系着预兆，一个一个不存在这里购美的预兆，形成了金阁的主题。

en.t: Thus omen joined to omen, and one by one the omens of a beauty not present here formed the theme of the Golden Pavilion.

units.source_text: 这种预兆，原来就是虚无的兆头。

en.t: This kind of omen was, in truth, a sign of nothingness.

units.source_text: 虚无，原来就是这个美的结构。

en.t: Nothingness, in truth, was the very structure of this beauty.

units.source_text: 这些细部的美在未完成之时，各自都结含着虚无的预兆，木质结构尺寸比例精细而纤巧的这座建筑物，就像璎珞在风中日落似的，在虚无的预感中颤栗。

en.t: While these beauties of detail remained unfinished, each contained an omen of nothingness, and this wooden building, delicate and finely proportioned in every measure, trembled in the premonition of nothingness, like jeweled ornaments fading into sunset in the wind.
